text:
mike (sales): Heads-up — Acme POC failing intermittently against our private host. They see TLS handshake errors + sporadic 502s during sustained load.

anya (acct): Customer says DNS resolves to the private interface IP. App logs: 'tls: certificate not yet valid' and 'connection reset by peer'. They need this fixed before tomorrow's demo.

devin (eng-net): Can we get a failing curl -v and the FQDN? Also ask them to tcpdump the ENI/NAT during a failure window. My initial thought: NAT egress churn or conntrack exhaustion.

mike (sales): FQDN: acme-poc.private.rdwd.internal — curl output shows 'SSL certificate problem: certificate is not yet valid' when resolving to 10.8.2.21.

rebecca (eng-runtime): Our edge logs show handshake failures and some 429s tied to per-src rate limiting around the same timestamps.

devin (eng-net): Tell them to run: `sudo conntrack -L | wc -l` ; `sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max` ; `netstat -tan | grep TIME_WAIT | wc -l`. Also run `openssl s_client -connect 10.8.2.21:443 -servername acme-poc.private.rdwd.internal -status` to confirm SNI and OCSP.

ops-team (acme-ops): Quick update — conntrack was ~64k (we're at 65536). We'll raise nf_conntrack_max and retest now.

rebecca (eng-runtime): Temporary mitigation we can offer: whitelist their egress CIDR on the edge for the POC or relax per-source throttling while they test. Recommend long-lived keepalives from the client's app to reduce new TLS handshakes.

devin (eng-net): Longer-term: if they can create an Interface VPC Endpoint (PrivateLink) to our service it removes NAT churn and preserves SNI. We'll provide the service name if they want to go that route.

infra-bot: deploy: private-endpoint edge-service in zone-c (ips:10.8.2.21,10.8.2.22). cert managed by Redwood; OCSP stapling enabled; exp: 2025-02-02T00:00:00Z.

ops-team (acme-ops): Raised conntrack to 200k, retesting. Report in 10m.

ops-team (acme-ops): Retest passed 2k RPS for 10m with no TLS errors. Looks stable.

mike (sales): Thanks everyone — closing blocker for the demo. We'll follow up on PrivateLink + POC pricing if they want to harden.

anya (acct): Customer asked for cert rotation/OCSP blurb for their security questionnaire.

rebecca (eng-runtime): Blurb: "Redwood manages TLS termination for hosted private endpoints; certificates are rotated proactively, OCSP stapling enabled, and rotation events are auditable via the Console. Customer-managed certs supported for Private/Dedicated deployments."

mike (sales): Scheduling a short post-mortem with Acme infra tomorrow to decide if PrivateLink is needed. Great triage team. :rocket:
